Do not move, enlarge or lower any main figure or identifying object. Preserve Wyeth/Cornwell grouped narrative composition, hard hand-placed pixel clusters, edges and selective dithering. Replace the featureless flat retaining wall BELOW y50% with ONE enormous recessed stone arch opening, seen slightly from below, making the balcony part of a monumental aqueduct or palace arcade. The arch is a broad simple near-black silhouette with thick piers and an almost black empty interior, large calm value masses, subtle spatial depth, no busy brick pattern or bright detail. Do not add people, bodies, bones, rubble, tools, candles, water reflections or any identifying action to the lower half. That half remains subdued and overlay-safe, no second focal point. All living/dead/decorated faces remain completely indiscernible at full size; no eyes, noses or mouths, shrouds opaque. No writing, symbols, borders or UI.
